Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In 2001, there was a discussion of ammo cards and Ghoul Retainers.

Ghoul Retainers could not use ammo, because ammo cards referred to
minions, as in 'this minion inflics (blah) damage with this gun'.

Card text on ammo cards has changed, and they now say 'this gun inflicts'
instead of 'this minion inflicts'. Am I correct in concluding that
ammo cards can now be played on a gun and a Ghoul retainer striking with
that ammo'd up gun will inflict the ammo'd damage?

gomi
--
Tenser, said the Tensor;
